title: Weapons: fix the failing ridge-LOS unit test — all 33 weapon tests green
description: Fix the single failing test of the already-committed TASK-43 work: 'LOS against the seeded analytic terrain' in app/src/server/shard/shard.weapons.test.ts (a ship behind the ridge IS hit — shields 0.84 instead of 1 — because the sim tick's resolveRegime re-resolves the manually-added 'surface' ships to 'space' once their 3D distance to the planet anchor (10000, 0) exceeds the 1050 m atmosphere exit radius, and space ships skip terrain/LOS entirely). Debug it empirically, fix it (test placement — or, only if the evidence is unambiguous, a real bug in the committed laser sweep), and get both weapon test files fully green (18 + 15 = 33). Everything else in TASK-43 is committed and untouched by this task.

steps.description: Reproduce and pinpoint with a throwaway debug script
steps.details: cd app && npx vitest run src/server/shard/shard.weapons.test.ts — expect exactly 1 failure (the 'LOS against the seeded analytic terrain' test, assertion 'ship-p2 shields toBe(1)' receives 0.84). Recreate the throwaway tsx debug script (put it in /tmp — e.g. /tmp/los-debug.ts — never in the repo, never committed) that mirrors the failing test EXACTLY: same SYSTEM_SEED 'shard-weapons-los-seed', same makeRidgeShard/findRidge/surfaceShipFacingX code copied from the test (lines ~317-437), warmup 250 ms (advance(250) burning the 5-tick catch-up burst), then LOG AFTER warmup: entity.ship.regime and entity.planetId for both ships, the ship y positions (did the integrator move them?), and a replica of the laser's 20 m nose-ray sweep against shard.terrainHeightAt(planet.id, ...) to see which samples the shard's own sweep would take. This confirms or kills the regime-flip hypothesis before touching anything.

IF the regime flips to 'space' after warmup (the prime suspect): shrink findRidge's scan window from ±550 m around planetAnchor(0) to ±350, then ±300 if needed (the ridge must keep BOTH ships px±100 within the 1050 m exit radius with margin), and add an explicit guard right after warmup in the test — both ships must still be regime 'surface' with planetId set — so a future flip fails loudly instead of silently hitting. Verify the ships' y (hA+5 / hB+5) does not drift under the integrator (surface clamp should hold them). IF the regime holds but the hit still lands: the two suspects are (a) the explicit-target path's losClear (5-sample lineOfSight from TASK-42) passing where it should not, and (b) the sweep's endT boundary — the 20 m subsamples land at d=20,40,…,180 from the nose while the target sits ~197 m out, so an occluder in the gap (180, endT] is missed; widen findRidge's occlusion predicate (require an occluding sample at d=180, or coverage reaching ~190 m) or relocate the ridge so an occluding sample lands before endT. IF the evidence shows a real bug in the committed laser sweep/LOS in shard.ts rather than the test setup: fix it MINIMALLY, keep this test as the regression, and re-run the whole file — the 14 already-green tests must stay green. Do NOT refactor working code for style, and do NOT re-derive the dead ends in the notes.

cd app && npx vitest run src/shared/weapons.test.ts src/server/shard/shard.weapons.test.ts → 33 passed / 0 failed; npx tsc --noEmit clean; delete the /tmp debug script; npx eslint --fix + npx prettier --write on the touched files; commit with a Conventional Commit message (e.g. 'test(weapons): TASK-43.1 ridge-LOS test green — <one-line cause>'). If the fix does not converge in time, leave an UPDATED .ralph/handoff/TASK-43.md (overwrite the stale one) stating exactly which hypothesis was confirmed/killed, what the debug script logged, and the single next action — the next attempt must not re-derive any of it.

acceptanceCriteria: shard.weapons.test.ts 'LOS against the seeded analytic terrain' passes both parts: the low ship behind the ridge is NOT hit (shields stay 1, hull 1, zero 'hit' events) and the same geometry at +2000 m altitude IS hit (shields 1 − 8/50, exactly one 'hit' event)
Both weapon test files fully green: cd app && npx vitest run src/shared/weapons.test.ts src/server/shard/shard.weapons.test.ts → 33 passed / 0 failed
The 14 previously-green shard.weapons tests and all 18 shared weapons tests stay green — production code changes ONLY if a real bug is proven, and then minimally with this test as the regression
npx tsc --noEmit clean; eslint + prettier clean on touched files; no throwaway script committed; work committed with a Conventional Commit message

BUG FIXES IN THE COMMITTED CODE (trust these versions, do not 'fix' them again): (a) turnToward was broken before 2547175 (Rodrigues term + magnitude multiplication → 14400 u/s + NaN); the committed form v' = v·cosθ + (k̂×v)·sinθ is verified numerically by weapons.test.ts. (b) denied missile fires no longer spend energy — handleFire rejects no-valid-target BEFORE committing, fireMissile refunds in the tick if the target is lost between acceptance and tick. Do NOT trust any pre-2547175 missile flight behavior.

THE ONE FAILING TEST: 'shard.weapons.test.ts > LOS against the seeded analytic terrain > a ship behind the ridge is NOT hit; the same engagement clears at high altitude' — assertion expect(shards).toBe(1) receives 0.84 (the hit lands). Working hypothesis: tick's resolveRegime flips the manually-added 'surface' ships to 'space' (3D distance to planetAnchor(0) = (10000, 0) exceeds the 1050 m exit radius) → space skips terrain/LOS → shot always lands. The high-altitude second part of the test (+2000 m) presumably passes or is masked by the same bug — check which assertions actually fire when debugging.

DEAD ENDS (already spent attempts on these — do not re-derive): (1) findRidge window [2000, 4200] (copied from shard.combat.test.ts) DOES NOT WORK for tests that run sim ticks — ships 6-8 km from the anchor get re-resolved to 'space'; shard.combat.test.ts only works because it calls resolveHit directly and never calls shard.sim.step. (2) A ±850 m window is NOT ENOUGH — a ridge found at (9150, −800) is 1.25 km from the anchor → beyond the 1050 m radius → ships still flipped to 'space' (verified by a now-lost /tmp debug script: 'p1 … regime space planetId undefined', yet the manual sweep showed 'd=20 point y=154 terrain=188 -> OCCLUDED' — the shard's own sweep is SKIPPED for space ships). (3) The current ±550 m window found a sweep-occluding ridge at px 9450, pz −550 (drop 12, occlusion h(sample) > hA + 8), ships at px±100 with y ≈ 250 ≈ 900 m from the anchor — SHOULD stay in atmosphere, yet the test still fails: that is exactly what step 1's debug script must settle.

TEST-STATE PITFALLS (from the attempts): (a) tick regen materializes energy on the first tick (undefined → 100) and adds 0.5 u per 50 ms tick — assert exact post-regen values (e.g. 98.5 one tick after a laser fire) or check immediately after handleFire; (b) the shard's projectileSeq starts at 1 — pre-seeded test projectiles must use ids proj:101+ (the 16-cap sorts by spawnTick, not id); (c) proj.ttl after one tick is 99, not 100 (updateProjectiles decrements in the spawn tick — processFireIntents runs first); (d) pure stepMissile at a stationary target OVERSHOOTS (the shard detonates on the first tick with gap ≤ 5 m) — loop until gap < 5 and record the contact step; (e) test convention: fake now closure + advance(shard, ms) per 50 ms + warmup(shard) = one advance(250) to burn the SimLoop's 5-tick catch-up burst, so each later advance(50) = exactly 1 tick (see shard.mining.test.ts).

AFTER THIS TASK: TASK-43.2 (WS integration test: A fires at B, B's shields drop, C sees the FX events) and TASK-43.3 (e2e laser-flash screenshot + full suite + lint + TASK-43 bookkeeping/close-out). This task does NOT touch the WS/e2e/bookkeeping — leave them for their tasks.
